Jamaican Patties are an incredibly popular savoury treat eaten across the whole of Jamaica and now widely available in other Caribbean islands,Canada and the USA.
The product and name are almost certainly derived from Cornish Pasties introduced to the island by Cornish sailors and settlers. Cornwall is one of the 3 counties that make up Jamaica to this day and contains many familiar place names such as Falmouth and Trelawny.
Traditional Jamaican Patties have a crispy pastry and crust usually made with Tumeric which gives the pastry it’s distinctive colour.
Beef,Chicken and Vegetables are probably the original fillings but over time patties in Jamaica have incorporated many other flavours including seafood and cheese. The filling is seasoned with, amongst other ingredients, mixed spices, Scallions, Thyme and Scotch Bonnet Peppers to give a unique flavour.
Patties are eaten in Jamaica at any time of day or night and can be a main meal or just a snack.
JPC’s patties are made to a traditional recipe and baked in store to ensure an authentic experience.
As well as traditional flavours JPC has created Curried Goat,Jerk Chicken and Ackee & Saltfish patties so that UK consumers can experience the flavours of other Jamaican foods in patty form.

Great steaks... and that''s no bull! Set in a modern steakhouse ambience overlooking the Canary Wharf quay side, Manhattan Grill offers the ultimate steak for those meat lovers out there.

Our USDA beef comes from the great American plains and is grain-fed for 150 days for unique marbling, subtle texture and unsurpassed flavour. We also offer a wide variety of fine wines from South Africa, Chile, Argentina and France which can be bought by the bottle or by the glass, thanks to a high-tech wine preserving system.

Our G&Tea Lounge is a great place to meet with friends and colleagues for pre-dinner drinks. With a relaxed mood by day and a vibrant air by night, it is the ideal place for unwinding and recharging, or for an informal gathering after hours. Sample a few gins from our extensive collection of over 180 types, or join us for that quintessentially-British afternoon tea experience. The freshly-baked scones, delicious sandwiches and decadent pastries are to die for, and the Champagne toast is a must.

Pret operates a bit like a restaurant. We build kitchens in (or very near) every shop. You won't find 'sell-by' dates on our freshly-made (and delicious) sandwiches and salads. We offer our unsold food to charity at the end of each day rather than keeping it to sell the next day. Our milk and coffee is 100% organic.

You can order the same freshly prepared food served in our lovely Canary Wharf shops for delivery (or collection) at www.pret.co.uk/pret-delivers.

IPPUDO brings to Canary Wharf the best of ramen, the soul food of Japan!
World renowned for its reinvented Hakata-style tonkotsu (pork-based) ramen, IPPUDO believes in fusing high quality local ingredients to Japanese elements. Here in London, we offer a variety of tasty broths (tonkotsu, chicken or vegetarian) and our original house-made noodles, for perfect bowls of piping-hot ramen.

IPPUDO's aim is to continue spreading smiles and "Arigato" through bowls of delicious ramen, in a vibrant and authentic ambience.

The Canary Wharf restaurant is open for lunch and dinner every day of the week with fresh pasta, antipasti, secondi and dolci taking centre stage. ⁠The ground-floor delicatessen serves fresh salads, homemade panini, cakes and Italian coffee for breakfast or lunch on the move while Bar Lina offers creative twists on Italian cocktails for aperitivo hour and late into the night.

Hi! We're Claudia and Otto Boyer 

We were both wired and jittery, running on too much coffee and not enough calm. Then we discovered matcha.

But finding delicious matcha in the UK? Impossible. So we went to Japan to source the best, meeting the makers, tasting hundreds, and learning what makes matcha truly great.

We brought that discovery home, creating JENKI in 2020 to share the ultimate matcha experience with London and beyond.

Our name comes from genki 元気, the Japanese word for life force, energy, and vitality. That’s what we’re here to spread: clean green energy that lifts you up, not crashes you down.

For 10,950 mornings – or 30 years – the pursuit of better ingredients, better craftsmanship and better taste has been what gets Ole & Steen up in the morning. It’s this pursuit that made two Danish bakers wake up with the same vision all those years ago – to create a better bakery for all. Better morning coffee and weekend delights. Better lunches, treats and celebrations. How? By refining simple recipes, experimenting and serving the result in beautiful surroundings.

It’s now been 30 years since it all started in our first Lagkagehuset bakery in Copenhagen, and our first UK bakery opened on 19th December 2016 on Haymarket, under the name “Ole & Steen”. Today more than 300 bakers work to support the Danish, London and New York bakeries. We have a few more bakeries these days and we want even more people to be able to wake up to better bread. So, whether you live in Denmark, London or New York, that’s what gets us up – morning after morning, year after year.

Since first opening in London at the end of 2016, Denmark's favourite bakers have wowed locals, visitors and media with the extraordinary quality of their bread, pastries and cakes. A household name back home, Ole & Steen have truly taken London by storm and have now brought their outstanding food to Canary Wharf with a new bakery at Crossrail Place.

Open from early breakfast until late, the bakery offers everything from single-estate coffee, cold-pressed juices, and snegl (delicious cinnamon pastry swirls) to lunchtime open sandwiches on rye bread - including the mouth-watering open rye sandwich with rare roast beef, remoulade, pickled cucumber and crispy shallots, or Danish blue cheese with pear, chestnuts and watercress, artisan sandwich baguettes and premium salads.

Ole & Steen is also the perfect place to wind-down with friends after work with a selection of wines and beers, mouth-watering flavoured focaccia, amazing flatbreads and warming stews of the day served with moorish skagen bread.

name.text: Obicà – Mozzarella Bar, Pizza e Cucina

description.text:
Obicà Mozzarella Bar is a casual and contemporary Italian restaurant. With its friendly welcoming atmosphere, Obica  offers a genuine Italian dining experience centered on the freshest Mozzarella di Bufala Campana DOP paired with other authentic products from Italy's rich regional heritage.

The philosophy of Obicà is summed up in the concept of Food to share, the pleasure of sharing good food with family and friends: a food concept created with Chef Alessandro Borghese, Obicà Creative Chef.

At Obicà the focus is on fresh and high-quality ingredients, that you can discover and taste in pasta dishes and pizza, salads, panini and desserts. All ingredients come from carefully selected suppliers, to offer you the best of Italian food culture.

The Obicà experience is completed by a selection of Italian wine labels and original cocktails, made with the best spirits.

Started in Italy in 2004, today Obica  has restaurants in international gateway cities such as Rome, Milan, Florence, London, New York, Tokyo and Los Angeles, where it continues to delight fans of fine Italian food wherever it opens.

At the bar, diners can enjoy the full menu as well as small bites, cocktails and an extensive selection of 48 different Italian wines from all Italian regions

Obicà Canary Wharf also serves coffee, panini, salads and pastries to take away. Visit us for drinks and aperitivo in the sun, or a relaxed, authentic Italian meal with colleagues.

Location: West Wintergarden
